evidence.title: What's New in Quantum Computing? Nasdaq Explores the Sector's Rise in Innovation and Investment
evidence.body: [e001:f01] There has been an increase in companies developing the technology entering the public markets in recent years, private investment is accelerating, and [Nasdaq Global Indexes has added quantum computing](https:// to one of its leading innovation indexes. [e001:f02] According to [McKinsey research](https:// quantum computing could generate multi-billion-dollar enterprise value over the next decade, with an economic impact that could reach approximately $2.7 trillion by 2035. [e001:f03] "Quantum technology helps organizations solve problems that are currently costly, difficult, or impractical using classical computers," said Ilaria Sangalli, Head of Index Insights for EMEA at Nasdaq, who authored the index team's research on the quantum sub-theme. [e001:f04] Fifteen Nasdaq-listed U.S. companies specializing in AI and quantum computing hardware and software, have a combined market capitalization of about $3.78 trillion. [e001:f05] Three-quarters of those companies have listed since 2020, including the recent listings of D-Wave Quantum, Quantinuum, and IQM Quantum Computers, with the largest wave arriving in 2021 and a new cohort emerging in the last two years._[1]_ The pattern resembles earlier cycles in AI, cloud computing, and cybersecurity, when investors began to treat each as a distinct category. [e001:f06] Since its launch on November 12, 2018, NYGBIG has delivered a total return of approximately 384% (22.8% on an annualized basis). [e001:f07] Since July 2023, NYGBIG generated a total return of 139% (33% on an annualized basis), outperforming the Nasdaq-100®, broader U.S. equities, and several established AI benchmarks._[2]_ Of the 1,181 companies with patent activity related to NYGBIG's sub-themes, 247 held patents connected to quantum computing. [e001:f08] "The two technologies may reinforce one another rather than develop independently," Sangalli said. [Investment continues to grow.](https:// Quantum technology startups attracted $12.6 billion in venture and private funding in 2025, more than six times the 2024 level, with roughly 90% directed at quantum computing specifically. [e001:f09] Governments are engaged, viewing the technology as critical for national security and cryptography; the U.S. government announced about $2 billion in quantum commitments in May 2026 and has taken minority stakes in leading companies. [e001:f10] Public money made up about one-third of total investment in 2024 and just 3% in 2025. [e001:f11] Sangalli expects interest in quantum to build as more commercial use cases emerge, with investors gaining exposure through a mix of pure-play quantum companies and larger technology firms investing in the technology through R&D spending, including patent development. [e001:f12] "It's much more." _**Sources:**_ _[1] Source: Pitchbook and Factset_ _[2] Nasdaq and Bloomberg_ _[3] Nasdaq AI Team, Nasdaq, IFI Claims. [e001:f13] Nasdaq cautions readers that any forward-looking information is not a guarantee of future performance and that actual results could differ materially from those contained in the forward-looking information. [e001:f14] Such forward-looking statements include, but are not limited to, statements regarding the potential economic impact and commercial applications of quantum computing, future investment and investor interest, the convergence of quantum computing and artificial intelligence, the development of quantum technologies, and anticipated changes in the composition or boundaries of the technology sector. [e001:f15] Securities and Exchange Commission, including its annual reports on Form 10-K and quarterly reports on Form 10-Q which are available on Nasdaq’s investor relations website at_[_http://_](https:// the SEC’s website at_[_www._](https:// Nasdaq undertakes no obligation to publicly update any forward-looking statement, whether as a result of new information, future events or otherwise._ _**Disclaimer:**_ _Nasdaq®, Nasdaq-100®, Nasdaq Global Artificial Intelligence and Big Data™ and NYGBIG™, are registered trademarks of Nasdaq, Inc. [e001:f16] The information contained above is provided for informational and educational purposes only, and nothing contained herein should be construed as investment advice, either on behalf of a particular security or an overall investment strategy.

evidence.title: Euro weakens below 1.1450 on hawkish Fed signals, German political risks
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The US Dollar (USD) strengthens against the Euro (EUR) on the hawkish stance of the US Federal Reserve (Fed) and the prospect of further interest rate hikes. [e002:f02] Fed's Collins delivered hawkish remarks, saying that she supported a rate hike. [e002:f03] Boston Fed President Susan Collins said on Tuesday that she supported the US central bank's decision last week to raise interest rates ‌in the face of risks that future inflation will be above the 2% target. [e002:f04] "I now see an increased likelihood of future scenarios in which inflation remains notably above 2%,” Collins added. [e002:f05] Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem said that additional rate increases may be necessary to achieve the Fed’s inflation US central bank last week decided to raise its interest rate target by 25 basis points (bps) to the 3.75%-4.00% range, and policymakers penciled in another rate increase before the year-end. [e002:f06] Euro supported as softer oil and yield spreads underpin EUR-USD fair valueStrategists at Scotiabank point out that the “renewed decline in the price of oil is a positive for the EUR, given the euro area’s terms of trade and its dependence on energy imports.” They add that yield differentials continue to work in the single currency’s favour, noting that “yield spreads remain supportive, with a narrow (2Y Germany-US yield spread only) FV estimate hovering just above 1.15.”Collins flags higher inflation risks, backing a more restrictive Fed stanceFed's Collins delivered a notably more hawkish tone, with the 8.1/10 FXS Speechtracker score standing well above the 6.6/10 historical average, underscoring a firmer commitment to tightening. [e002:f07] The emphasis on an "increased likelihood" that inflation stays "notably above 2%" and the view that a stronger labor market allows policy to focus squarely on restoring price stability after years of elevated inflation point to support for keeping the FEDERAL FUNDS RATE somewhat more restrictive for longer. [e002:f08] This combination of heightened inflation concern and confidence in labor market resilience is typically supportive of the Dollar and negative for risk-sensitive FXS Fed Sentiment Index rose by 0.53 points to 150.49, reinforcing that the broader Fed communication backdrop remains firmly in hawkish territory. [e002:f09] With the index far above the neutral 100 mark and the latest speech scoring well above the established baseline, the data signal persistent upside risks for U.S. yields and the Dollar as markets price in a longer period of restrictive Analysis: EUR/USD remains capped under the 100-day SMAIn the daily chart, EUR/USD maintains a bearish near-term tone as it holds below both the 100-day moving average (MA) and the Bollinger Bands’ 20-day simple moving average (SMA) center line. [e002:f10] In 2022, it accounted for 31% of all foreign exchange transactions, with an average daily turnover of over $2.2 trillion a day. [e002:f11] EUR/USD is the most heavily traded currency pair in the world, accounting for an estimated 30% off all transactions, followed by EUR/JPY (4%), EUR/GBP (3%) and EUR/AUD (2%). [e002:f12] If inflation rises more than expected, especially if above the ECB’s 2% target, it obliges the ECB to raise interest rates to bring it back under control. [e002:f13] Relatively high interest rates compared to its counterparts will usually benefit the Euro, as it makes the region more attractive as a place for global investors to park their money. [e002:f14] Indicators such as GDP, Manufacturing and Services PMIs, employment, and consumer sentiment surveys can all influence the direction of the single currency. [e002:f15] Economic data for the four largest economies in the euro area (Germany, France, Italy and Spain) are especially significant, as they account for 75% of the Eurozone’s economy. [e002:f16] Another significant data release for the Euro is the Trade Balance.

evidence.title: 米国株トレンド（9月22日）：Metaが11%急騰、AMDの時価総額が1兆米ドルを突破、ナスダック総合指数が過去最高値を更新
evidence.body: [e003:f01] S&P 500指数は1.49％上昇の7764.70ポイント、ナスダック指数は2.26％上昇の27122.090ポイント、ダウ平均株価は0.71％上昇の52048.83ポイントを付けた。 [e003:f02] Meta傘下のAIエージェント「Muse」が米国App Store無料アプリランキングで1位を獲得し、AIエージェントへの熱機運がすぐにCPUおよびAIハードウェア銘柄に波及した。 [e003:f03] AMD、インテル、クアルコム、ARMが集団的に大幅上昇し、その中でAMDの時価総額が初めて1兆ドルを突破した。 [e003:f04] 原油価格の大幅下落と10年物米国債利回りが5％を下回る水準まで戻ったことで、高バリュエーションの科技株が資金調達や上昇するための空間も生み出された。 [e003:f05] ナスダック指数が新高記録、フィラデルフィア半導体指数が4.29％上昇 S&P 500指数は1.49％上昇の7764.70ポイント、ナスダック指数は2.26％上昇の27122.090ポイントをつけ史上初の終値高値を記録。 [e003:f06] VIX指数は14.87と小幅に0.41％上昇した。 [e003:f07] フィラデルフィア半導体指数は4.29％上昇し、8月4日以来となる単日で最高のパフォーマンスを記録した。 [e003:f08] Metaが11.43％、テスラが3.03％、NVIDIAが2.30％、Amazonが1.87％、Microsoftが1.59％、Alphabetが1.55％、Appleが0.85％それぞれ上昇した。 [e003:f09] 2年物米国債利回りは小幅に4.751％まで上昇、10年物は約4.5bp低下して4.951％となった。 [e003:f10] WTI原油は4.86％下落し95.43ドル/バレル、ブレント原油は3.62％下落して100ドル台前半へ。 [e003:f11] ビットコインは8万6千ドルを突破して8カ月ぶりの高値を更新、Ethereumも2700ドルを超えた。 [e003:f12] MetaはAMDの重要顧客の一つであり、両社は今年何年にもわたる契約を締結済みで、最大6GW規模のAMD Instinct GPUの導入を計画している。 [e003:f13] マイクロンは2.77％上昇、マウェラーは5.38％上昇、アプリケーション・マテリアルズは4.42％上昇、コーニングは5.89％上昇、ルメンタムは2.53％上昇した。 [e003:f14] 過去1週間、市場はAI安全性に関する議論による急落を経験したばかりだったが、昨夜の反発は単純な底値買いから新たな産業的要因駆動型へ変化しつつある。 [e003:f15] 原油価格が96ドル割れ、10年物米国債が再び5％下に回復 科技株の上昇にはもう一つの重要な背景がある。 [e003:f16] 貿易面では、11月に期限切れとなる関税暫定停止期間の延長与否を決定するに至らず、高度なAIチップの輸出規制についても今回の協議で新たな突破口は見いだせなかった。

evidence.title: Sagen MI Canada Inc. Completes Issuance of $300 Million of Unsecured Debentures due September 22, 2033 and Announces Redemption Price for 2.955% Debentures due March 1, 2027
evidence.body: [e004:f01] 22, 2026 /CNW/ -- Sagen MI Canada Inc. (the "Company" or "Sagen") (TSX: .A) announced today that it completed its previously announced offering (the "Offering") of $300 million of 4.947% debentures due September 22, 2033 by way of private placement under applicable Canadian securities laws. [e004:f02] The Offering was made through a syndicate of agents led by BMO Capital Markets and Scotiabank, including CIBC World Markets, RBC Capital Markets, TD Securities and National Bank Financial. [e004:f03] As announced on September 15, 2026, the Company will redeem all of its outstanding 2.955% debentures due March 1, 2027 (the "Redeemed Debentures"), in the aggregate principal amount of $282 million, on September 25, 2026 (the "Redemption Date"). [e004:f04] Pursuant to the terms of the trust indenture governing the Redeemed Debentures, the Redeemed Debentures will be redeemed on the Redemption Date at a price equal to the greater of the "Canada Yield Price" and par, together in each case with accrued and unpaid interest to the Redemption Date. [e004:f05] The Canada Yield Price, calculated today in accordance with the governing trust indenture, is approximately $1,000.13389 per $1,000 of principal amount of Redeemed Debentures. [e004:f06] Accordingly, all of the outstanding Redeemed Debentures will be redeemed on the Redemption Date at the Canada Yield Price, plus approximately $1.943014 per $1,000 of principal amount of Redeemed Debentures for accrued and unpaid interest up to, but excluding, the Redemption Date. [e004:f07] The aggregate redemption price payable by the Company on the Redemption Date, including accrued and unpaid interest, is approximately $282,585,686.84. [e004:f08] About Sagen MI Canada Inc. [e004:f10] For more than three decades, the Company has supported the housing market by providing thought leadership and a focus on the safety and soundness of the mortgage finance system. evidence.title: OBE Power Closes Equity Investment from North Sky Capital to Support Expansion of Its EV Charging Network Across the U.S. and Canada
evidence.body: [e005:f01] The new capital will strengthen OBE Power’s ability to accelerate deployment of EV charging infrastructure, with a focus on multifamily, hospitality, healthcare, commercial, and other destination-based properties. [e005:f02] The transaction is designed to optimize OBE Power’s capital structure while providing the financial capacity required to support the company’s aggressive expansion plan over the next several years. [e005:f03] “We are proud to welcome North Sky Capital as a strategic partner, given its strong commitment to impact investing and deep understanding of the renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure sectors,” said Luis Paul, Cofounder and Managing Director of OBE Power. [e005:f04] “With this strategic investment, OBE Power has secured the capital foundation required to support its ambitious expansion goals over the next three to five years.” OBE Power’s business model is focused on deploying, owning, operating, and managing EV charging infrastructure for property owners and institutional partners, allowing hosts to provide EV charging solutions without making significant capital investments or assuming operational complexity. [e005:f05] The company’s platform combines infrastructure deployment, network operations, maintenance, driver support, energy reimbursement, and carbon credit income management. [e005:f06] “North Sky Capital has evaluated the EV charging sector for several years, and we believe OBE Power presents a compelling and well-structured expansion opportunity in the market,” said Adam Bernstein, Managing Director of North Sky Capital. [e005:f07] “OBE Power’s fully owned and operated model, experienced management team, and clear growth strategy are aligned with the goals of our infrastructure investment strategy,” added Ying Lucy Fan, Principal on North Sky’s infrastructure team. [e005:f08] The transaction represents an important milestone for OBE Power as the company continues to scale its EV charging network and support the transition toward cleaner transportation infrastructure across North America. [e005:f09] About OBE Power OBE Power is an electric vehicle charging infrastructure company focused on the deployment, ownership, operation, and management of EV charging networks across the United States and Canada. [e005:f10] The company provides fully managed EV charging solutions for multifamily, hospitality, healthcare, commercial, and destination-based properties, enabling property owners and institutional partners to offer EV charging services without direct capital investment or operational burden. [e005:f11] For more information, visit [https://](https:// About North Sky Capital North Sky is a pioneer in impact investing in the United States. [e005:f12] Now in its 26th year, North Sky has deployed more than $1.7 billion across approximately 200 impact investments on behalf of its various impact funds. [e005:f13] The Firm’s flagship strategies support positive environmental and social impact while targeting market-rate investment returns. [e005:f14] North Sky has been an active impact investor since the beginning of the modern era of private markets impact investing in 2005.

evidence.title: Nasdaq hits record high as oil prices fall below $100
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Santiago / Getty Images On Tuesday, the Nasdaq $NDAQ Composite climbed to a new all-time intraday peak and was on track for a second straight record close, buoyed by a drop in oil prices that gave technology stocks a lift. [e003:f02] The S&P 500 traded near flat, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell roughly 260 points, or about 0.5%. [e003:f03] Brent crude futures slipped below $100 a barrel, down about 0.5% on the day. [e003:f04] Oil moved lower after encouraging signs on Middle East supply. [e003:f05] Tests are underway on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline, with flows potentially resuming as soon as this week. [e003:f06] Japan's Kyodo News Agency, according to The Wall Street Journal , also reported that Iran offered to restore access through the Strait of Hormuz contingent on the U.S. ending its blockade. [e003:f07] Those reports have not been independently verified, according to CNBC . [e003:f08] The Nasdaq 's gain was supported in part by a 4% rise in SanDisk stock following a call from Rosenblatt, according to CNBC. [e003:f09] The 10-year Treasury yield edged up to around 4.97% to 4.98%. [e003:f10] Monday's session set a strong tone heading into Tuesday, with the S&P 500 logging its biggest one-day advance since August 4 and the Nasdaq achieving its first record close since June, both fueled by retreating oil prices and easing Treasury yields. [e003:f11] President Donald Trump, taking the podium at the United Nations General Assembly on Tuesday, told world leaders he must make a "big decision" about whether to seek a negotiated settlement with Iran or "annihilate" the country. [e003:f12] He added that he expects a deal will come together after the midterm elections. [e003:f13] Oil prices were little changed following his remarks. [e003:f14] Markets are also focused on whether a face-to-face between Trump and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian will occur, following Trump's remarks over the weekend that he was open to the possibility, according to The Wall Street Journal. [e003:f15] Attention is also turning to a planned summit in Washington between Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping later this week. [e003:f16] Join 500,000+ readers who start their day with Quartz.

evidence.title: いまさら聞けない「米国の雇用が世界経済にとって最も重要」なワケ…崩れたら株が「大暴落」（クーリエ・ジャポン）
evidence.body: [e004:f01] 【見る】プロこうして「上がる株」を判断する 分析に「本当に役立つ」指標の名前 【第3回】プロはこうして「上がる株」を判断する 分析に「本当に役立つ」指標の名前 なぜ投資には米国の指標が重要なのか ──著書の『武器になる経済指標』の冒頭は、米国の指標からはじまっていますが、なぜ米国から解説がはじまるのでしょうか。 [e004:f02] 米国は非常に大きな経済規模を持ち、1ヵ国で世界のGDPのおよそ4分の1を占めています。 [e004:f03] 世界中の投資家が米国の雇用統計を注視している理由としてポイントを挙げると、米国のGDPの約7割を個人消費が占めているからです。 [e004:f04] つまり、世界のGDPの約4分の1を占める米国経済の約7割が個人消費によるもので、これを単純に掛け合わせれば、米国の個人消費だけで世界経済の約2割を占める計算になります。 [e004:f05] では、米国の個人消費はどのような状況で伸びるのかと言えば、雇用が増加し失業率が安定しているときです。 [e004:f06] したがって、米国の雇用統計を確認されおけば、世界経済がどの方向に向かっているのかを、かなりの範囲まで把握できるのです。 [e004:f07] 日本では「令和のブラックマンデー」などと呼ばれましたが、その直前には、米国の雇用情勢が悪化しているのではないかという懸念が広がっていました。 [e004:f08] 当時は米国の失業率が上昇しはじめるなど、雇用市場の弱さを示す兆候が出ていたため、市場参加者が一斉にリスクを回避し、資金を引き上げる事態になりました。 [e004:f09] しかし、雇用統計も決して完璧なデータではありません。 [e004:f10] 米国ほど人口規模の大きな国で、毎月の雇用者数が10万人増えたのか、15万人増えたのかという違いは、誤差の範囲です。 [e004:f11] 雇用統計の速報値には一定のノイズが含まれていて、2ヵ月ほどかけて修正された結果、実際にはそこまで「雇用が弱い」という現象はありませんでした。 [e004:f12] 最近では、むしろ雇用者数の勢いが戻りつつあるので、現時点では、最も重要な米国の雇用と個人消費が大きく崩れる事態には至っていません。 [e004:f13] 米国の雇用統計が堅調である間は、中長期的に見れば、世界経済や世界の企業収益全体が改善していく可能性が高く、それに伴って株価も上昇していくと考えられます。 [e004:f14] 米国の雇用が減少方向に向かいそうだから、株をすべて売却するべきかと言えば、そう単純な話でもありません。 [e004:f15] しかも単なる景気を下支えするだけでなく、その後は需要を強く刺激する方向に政策が動いたため、結果として株価が大きく上昇する展開にもなりました。 [e004:f16] 次ページは：「AIバブル」が「ITバブル」と異なる理由 前へ 1 2 次へ 1 / 2ページ 【関連記事】 2030年、日本円は「70円台」の超円高に…日本人だけが気づかない「為替」の意外な盲点 「絶対にやめろ」の忠告を無視…1日で2400万円を失った投資家の末路 給料が上がっても喜べない…日本を破壊する「賃金上昇」の意外な落とし穴 プロはこうして「上がる株」を判断している…企業分析に「本当に役立つ」指標の名前【エコノミストが明かす】 日本株「爆上がり」のウラで、賢い人が「避けている」投資先の名前。
